source_holds.exact_narration: Before taking over a command workstation, check which application and environment you are using. We begin in IC's Calls workspace, with the department's training incidents already listed.
Open the menu at the upper left and choose Settings.

At the top, App Info shows App Name, Version and Environment; this example identifies Resgrid IC in development. That gives a command aide useful details when reporting a problem. For practice, locate those three values, then find the Account section directly underneath before reviewing connection or sign-in settings.
In Settings, Account, open Server to inspect the connection address.

The form shows Custom and a complete Server URL; the loopback address here belongs to this local training environment. Use the address supplied by your administrator for your own installation. The note says to leave off the API version path and a trailing slash. Cancel closes this review without saving a different server. During a command handover, comparing the address first helps avoid troubleshooting the wrong installation. Practice finding the complete address rather than relying on the shortened Account row.
Back in Account, choose Sign-in and security.

required_labels_from_frozen_hold: Not set up. Set one up in Resgrid on the web.
No passkeys for this app yet.
No verifications in the last 30 days.
source_holds.exact_narration: Read each section as the current account's summary. Here, Authenticator app says it is not set up, and Passkeys for this app says there are none yet. Responder approvals lists Macintosh with Approvals stopped. Recent verifications reports no verifications in the last thirty days. These are separate facts, so check each rather than treating one heading as a general security verdict. If your department requires another method, arrange its approved setup separately. This review does not enroll an authenticator or create a passkey.

opens the Username and Password form. Both fields are empty in this demonstration, and Cancel and Save are visible together. Save submits these details to sign in; it is not an account password-change screen. For a routine workstation review, leave the fields empty and choose Cancel. This is especially useful when a supervisor is showing a colleague where account access lives: you can explain the form without putting anyone's credentials into a shared presentation or recording.

required_labels_from_frozen_hold: This takes effect the next time someone signs in on this device.
source_holds.exact_narration: is the place to review a workstation used by several operators. The page explains the shared-session purpose, shows This is a shared device switched on, and offers a Device label, which is optional. The important note says this takes effect the next time someone signs in on this device. The form shown here has not been saved, so its switch alone does not prove a shared policy is active. Before a shift handover, compare this choice with department guidance and decide who should configure it.

Lower in Settings, Preferences groups the display and device choices. Theme currently shows System, while Language shows Select option. Keep Alive is off, and BT Handset says No device selected. Check these displayed states before assuming a workstation has your preferred presentation or audio arrangement; this browser view does not demonstrate a connected handset or a device staying awake.

Immediately below, Support lists Help Center, Contact Us, System Status, Privacy Policy and Terms of Service. For practice, identify the appropriate support destination without opening an external page during this review.
In Settings, Sync and Offline Queue shows a Sync Status of Up to date. Choose View Sync Queue

for the detailed picture. This session is Online, with zero pending, zero failed and zero done, and the center says Queue is empty. The queue actions are disabled because there is nothing here to process or clear. An empty queue is a useful handover check, but it does not demonstrate an offline write or successful replay. Practice reading connectivity and all three counts together before describing the current sync state to another operator.

required_labels_from_frozen_hold: Are you sure you want to logout? This will clear all app data, cached values, and settings.
source_holds.exact_narration: to read Confirm Logout. The warning says logout will clear app data, cached values and settings. Choose Cancel to finish this review while keeping the session; an actual logout is a separate decision. The same checks help a fire or EMS command aide, a community crisis coordinator, a search-and-rescue lead, a security supervisor, a wildland command team or an industrial response desk. In each setting, a useful handover names the environment, account state and current queue rather than leaving the next operator to guess.
